## Invitations

The outreach exercise sent 6938 invitations across North City. Attendance reached 4595, representing a rate of 66.2 per cent. This provides a clear view of engagement with the invitation activity and indicates that many recipients took up the opportunity to attend.

Operational arrangements were maintained throughout the exercise. Van days were retained where roads allowed, supporting delivery in areas where access was suitable. The approach was kept practical and responsive to local conditions.

## Contact

Of the invitations issued, 5889 were sent with an SMS. This provided an additional prompt and supported contact with recipients through a direct messaging route. No reminder message was issued: the recorded reminder figure was 0.

The contact arrangements were aligned with the invitation process and helped provide a consistent approach for recipients. The report was prepared by G. Evans.
